messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: How plot bifactor test information?
parts:
Not easily, and this question has come up on this forum a few times so you should be able to find my recommendations. Sometimes the drop argument in itemplot() can help, but for the complete test information that will not be the case.

Phil
